config.resource_notes: Linux /proc process counters; main-thread context switches; RSS sampled every 500 ms. No hardware allocation/IOPS/network attribution.

method.ordering: alternating old/new and new/old per independent round; no concurrent build/test/benchmark
method.client: matched published 1.0.0 Node SDK vs local candidate 1.1.1 Node SDK; same API calls/configuration; full stack comparison, not an isolated engine-change attribution
method.limitations: Finite in-memory dataset and short phases on a shared laptop; not a service-level or cross-product claim.
